operator-walkthrough.ref: WHAT THE OPERATOR SEES after this diff (nickstire/site-real-photos, 2026-10-19), to be audited post-merge on nickstire.org by the owner on his phone: (1) Home: the hero is the real storefront photo (yellow sign over the open bays, the owner out front) with a fetch-priority preload mirrored in index.html, a three-photo proof row under it (pickup in the bays, technician on a wheel nut, new tires stacked outside), the brakes tile shows the worn rotor and pads, and the arrival pair (roadside sign approach, Euclid Ave entrance) sits beside the directions block. (2) /contact and /tire-shop-near-me: the same arrival pair next to the directions. (3) /tires (Tire Finder): new-tire stock and the alignment check photos. (4) /brakes: the worn rotor and pads. (5) /about: the crew on Euclid Ave and a crew member. Every photo ships as full, -medium and -small webp with a srcset and alt text in plain words; everything below the hero is lazy-loaded. site-real-photos.test.tsx pins the hero, the proof row, the arrival pair, that every rendered /photos/ URL in src and every srcset candidate is a real file in client/public/photos, and that the index.html preloads mirror the hero picture (red first 7 failed / 3 passed on the unchanged pages; mutations: missing hero variant, empty alt, deleted -small file, 5 failed / 6 passed). Not device-tested before merge: the 375 px look and the hero's largest-contentful-paint on a real phone are owed after deploy; the prerendered tree is refreshed by the prerender-refresh workflow on merge, not by hand. UPDATE after the Codex review (3847f3aa1): five readable customer plates were found at 100 % crop in three photos (crew x2, Home storefront hero x2, entrance x1; triage had marked all three plate: false) and are redacted as soft flat patches in the full, -medium and -small files, measured inside vs outside the box with a re-encode control; the owner will see blank plates, no black boxes. On a phone, /brakes now loads the 113 KB -medium brake photo instead of the 580 KB full file (phone <source> carries only -small and -medium); tablets 769 to 1024 px still get the full file. The 30 photo files were all checked for plates and customer faces at 100 %: the other seven subjects show none readable.

capability-ledger-updated.ref: nickstire/site-real-photos (2026-10-19). The only client/src/lib change is photoSrcSet.ts, a 9-line helper that builds the srcset string (full, -medium, -small) for a /photos/ path; it adds no capability, state, route, provider or data path, so no capability-ledger.json entry changes state. Consumers: Home.tsx, About.tsx, TireFinderV2.tsx, BrakeRepairPage.tsx, FocusedServicePage.tsx, ArrivalPhotos.tsx; site-real-photos.test.tsx asserts every srcset candidate it emits is a real file in client/public/photos. The photos themselves come from the shop media library job (PR 3177), whose ledger entry covers media_assets.
